title: pyslicer YAML config
description: Print settings for pyslicer --config YAML files. All properties are optional. Unknown properties are rejected at load time. Prefer CLI-style aliases (layer_height, outer_speed, …) when both an alias and a Model attribute name exist.

layer_height.description: Slicing layer height in mm (alias for layerHeight).

num_perimeters.description: Minimum number of perimeters (alias for number_perimeters).

perimeter_overlap_percent.description: Percent overlap between perimeters. Smaller values mean more overlap.

append_perimeters.description: Also include original STL perimeters with no offsetting.

outer_speed.description: Outer perimeter print speed in mm/s (converted to Model outer_perimeter_speed mm/min).

inner_speed.description: Inner perimeter print speed in mm/s (converted to Model inner_perimeter_speed mm/min).

infill_speed.description: Infill print speed in mm/s (CLI convention; converted to Model mm/min). There is no separate mm/min YAML key for this setting.

max_corner_speed.description: Max speed at a sharp corner in mm/s (CLI convention; converted to Model mm/min). There is no separate mm/min YAML key for this setting.

outer_perimeter_speed.description: Outer perimeter print speed in mm/min (Model-native). Mutually exclusive with outer_speed.

inner_perimeter_speed.description: Inner perimeter print speed in mm/min (Model-native). Mutually exclusive with inner_speed.

default_print_speed.description: Default print speed in mm/min (G-code F).

max_accel.description: Max print acceleration for feed planning in mm/s².

max_jerk.description: Max corner speed change Δv for feed planning in mm/s.

min_corner_angle.description: Min turn angle in degrees before accel/jerk caps apply.

minimum_retract_travel.description: Minimum travel distance in mm before retracting.

width_over_height.description: Extrusion width relative to layer height.

min_extrude.description: Minimum extrusion length threshold in mm.

firmware.description: Firmware dialect for optional pressure-advance start G-code. none emits nothing.

pressure_advance.description: Pressure/linear advance value in firmware-native units. Emitted only when firmware is not none.

enable_dynamic_overhang_speeds.description: Slow perimeters based on unsupported overlap with the previous layer.

overhang_speed_0.description: Speed as percent of outer cruise at 0% overlap (full overhang).

overhang_speed_25.description: Speed as percent of outer cruise at 25% overlap.

overhang_speed_50.description: Speed as percent of outer cruise at 50% overlap.

overhang_speed_75.description: Speed as percent of outer cruise at 75% overlap.

min_layer_time.description: Minimum layer print time in seconds; 0 disables cooling slowdown.

slow_down_min_speed.description: Floor speed in mm/s when slowing for min layer time or overhangs (converted to mm/min).

dont_slow_down_outer_wall.description: When enforcing min_layer_time, prefer slowing inner walls and infill over outer walls.

seam_position.description: Where to place the Z-seam on closed perimeters.

wipe_distance.description: Wipe length in mm along the path after a perimeter; 0 disables.

wipe_on_loops.description: After a closed loop, tuck the nozzle slightly inward before traveling.

seam_gap.description: Shorten closed perimeter loops by this many mm at the seam.
